tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor bsnyen pa'i man ngag gsal ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo badzra pa ṇi ye/ rdo rje gtum po rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen dmigs dngos ni/ rang nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad steng rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'i lte bar/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rig 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba'i mtha' mar gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi sngags gsum gyis bskor ba la/ sngags phreng sbrul mgo langs pa lta bu las g.yas bskor du byung ba a wa dhū ti'i nang na mar song*/ rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi padma brgyud de/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs shing snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la bskor ba/ slar yang dbu ma'i lam nas song bar dmigs pa sogs gong bzhin te/ do la'i bzlas pa zhes sam/ 'khyogs kyi bzlas pa de lta bu la yengs med du dril/ skabs su dam tshig gi bzlas pa zhes saṃ/ don gnyis kyi dmigs pa bya ba ni/ de lta bu'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer rab 'byams su phog rgyal sras zhi khro rnams la mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba yongs rdzogs phul ba mnyes par byas de rnams kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du byung ba rang la thim pas byin rlabs smin cing dngos grub thob par bsam pa rang don dang*/ yang 'od zer 'gro drug gi gnas rnams su phog de rnams kyi sdig sgrib byang gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam pa ni gzhan don no// de ltar gyi dmigs pa thun gyi dngos gzhi dang rjes su sangs rgyas sems can bzang ngan du dbye ba'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lus rdo rje gtum por ye nas gnas par yin lugs shes pa'i nges shes dang*/ de rnams kyang phyi rol tu ma chad pa'i rang sems dang ro mnyam/ ༈ snang srid lha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha rang du shes pa/ gnyis med bde ba chen po rang rig pa'i gshis thog tu 'jog pa ni bskyed rdzogs kyi mthar thug pa'o// 'khor gyi bsnyen dmigs ni/

lha zhi drag so so'i thugs kar zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kṣa sogs so so'i sa bon gyi yi ges mtshon pa'i mthar lha rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga 'phros/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas phrin las thams cad bsgrub par mos nas/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs rim bzhin du bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni bzang po mdor bsdus las/ gtso bo 'bum dang 'khor la khri// rab 'bring mtshan ma mthong bar bya// zhes gsung bzhin dang*/ dkyil chog gzhan du/ grangs gtso bo la rab 'bum tsho sum cu so drug 'bring nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ tha ma bcu zhes gsungs kyang*/ 'dir gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi sngags sum sbrel la gzhung 'bum du gsungs kyang*/ rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur dbang du bya ba'am/ 'grub na 'bum phrag bcu drug go /'khor la khri bzhi'am/ de lhag gang 'grub dang*/ mtshan nyer gcig pa'i de bzhin brgyud las shin tu bsngags pa'i phan yon che bar gsungs bzhin las khri bzhir bzla ba yin no// de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen chen yongs su rdzogs pa'o// ces pa'ang chos spyan ldan pa'i bla ma dkon mchog dpal bzang gis bzhed don du/ ༈ snyom las pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis bsnyen dmigs rang rkyang mdo tsam 'phral du zin thor btab pa dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
